Name: Content Patcher Animations
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Content Patcher Animations[/b] lets you animate textures in Content Patcher with its [font=Courier New]EditImage[/font] action.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]For players[/size][/b]
Just install the mod and it'll work automatically for content packs that use it.

[b][size=3]For mod authors[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Create a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Add an [font=Courier New]EditImage[/font] patch for the image you want to animate.
[*]Give the patch a unique [font=Courier New]LogName[/font] value.
[*]Add these two fields to your patch:[list]
[*][font=Courier New]AnimationFrameTime[/font] is the number of ticks between each frame (in game ticks, which is 1/60thof a second);
[*][font=Courier New]AnimationFrameCount[/font] is the number of frames.
[/list]
[/list]All frames must be next to each other horizontally in the same [font=Courier New]FromFile[/font] image.

See the optional files for an example content pack.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]
[list]

[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods]Source code[/url]
[/list]
